"''No. With the Bothans will we speak. Determine their allegiance, we must.|Wullf Yularen and Yoda|}} A '''battle''' was fought in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] over the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] colony [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The Republic forces traveled to Kothlis to negotiate with the Bothans but were confronted by a Confederate [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] upon arrival. After a brief battle, however, the Separatist forces retreated. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], then entered negotiations with the Bothans' first secretary, [[Desark Fey'lya]], who thanked the Jedi for their efforts in repelling the Separatist attack. Tano, however, [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] that the secretary had probably invited the Separatists himself and expressed her concerns to the rest of the Jedi. Fey'lya felt insulted by Tano's words and declared that the Bothans and their [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Spynet]] would be open to both sides of the conflict. ==Prelude== In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces—consisting of several [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]]—traveled to the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] colony [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]], where [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] hoped to negotiate with the Bothans concerning their loyalty to the Republic. Upon arrival at Kothlis, however, the Republic found a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ships]] under the command of a [[Unidentified Neimoidian commander|Neimoidian]] in orbit. ==The battle== {{Quote|Their force nearly equals ours?! Unacceptable odds! Order an immediate retreat!|A Neimoidian commander|}} [[File:AhsokaRex-TheWindRaidersOfTaloraan.png|thumb|left|260px|Ahsoka Tano and Rex in their Y-wing preparing for a torpedo run.]] The Republic immediately attacked the Separatist ships with [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]], [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]], and two [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptors]] piloted by [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Skywalker and Kenobi, as well as Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]—who flew one of the Y-wings, with [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]] serving as her [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]]—engaged Confederate [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture Droid starfighters]]. At one point during the battle, Kenobi's [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|starfighter]] came under attack from two Vulture droids. Being unable to shake them, Kenobi contacted Skywalker and requested assistance. The latter advised Kenobi to drop down toward the planet, thus exposing the droids to Skywalker's attack. After Skywalker had rescued Kenobi, the two returned to the main battle. Meanwhile, Tano singlehandedly attacked one of the ''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ships and, using [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]], managed to destroy it. Seeing that his forces no longer outnumbered those of the Republic, the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] panicked and ordered an immediate retreat of his taskforce. Admiral Yularen asked Yoda if he should pursue the fleeing Separatists, but Yoda told him not to do this. Instead, the Jedi Master ordered to proceed with the original mission: to negotiate with the Bothans. ==Aftermath== {{Quote|We ''thank'' you for chasing away those Separatist scum who were intent on punishing us for that very loyalty!''"
"''He's ''lying'', masters!''"
"''I ''beg'' your pardon!''"
"''I could feel it in the ''Force'', masters! The first secretary was lying! He probably ''invited'' the Separatists here!|Desark Fey'lya and Ahsoka Tano|}} [[File:Kothlis-negotiations.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The Jedi negotiate with Desark Fey'lya.]] Yoda, Kenobi, Skywalker, and Tano soon landed on Kothlis and met with the Bothans' first secretary, [[Desark Fey'lya]], who thanked the Jedi for saving Kothlis from the Separatists. Tano, however, [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] that the first secretary was lying. She expressed her thoughts to the rest of the Jedi, telling them that Fey'lya had probably invited the Separatists himself. The first secretary took Tano's words as an insult and left, stating that the Bothans would remain neutral and provide their [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|spying]] services to both the Republic and the Separatists. Skywalker then told Tano that he, Kenobi, and Yoda had sensed Fey'lya's lie too but did not tell about it. Skywalker also explained to his Padawan that sometimes being a diplomat meant to allow a lie to achieve the mission's goal. Yoda then decided that Tano should learn diplomacy and sent her, along with Skywalker and Kenobi, to [[Mission to Taloraan|negotiate]] a treaty with the [[Denfrandi]] people on the planet [[Taloraan/Legends|Taloraan]]. ==Behind the scenes== The battle of Kothlis appeared in the [[Star Wars comic books|graphic novel]] ''[[The Clone Wars: The Wind Raiders of Taloraan]]'', written by [[John Ostrander]], illustrated by the [[Fillbach Brothers]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[May 27]], [[2009]].{{DarkHorse|url=Books/15-843/Star-Wars-The-Clone-Wars--The-Wind-Raiders-of-Taloraan|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars--The Wind Raiders of Taloraan}} The [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide|episode guide]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' places the issue between the episodes ''[[Lethal Trackdown]]'' and ''[[Corruption (episode)|Corruption]].'' ==Appearances== *''[[The Clone Wars: The Wind Raiders of Taloraan]]'' {{1st}} ==Sources== *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 5.13|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic 5.13]] *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]'' *{{FactFile2014|29|GRI 5-8|General Grievous}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Batalla de Kothlis (Guerras Clon) }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Kothlis, battle over}} [[Category:Battles of Kothlis]] [[Category:Battles of the Clone Wars]]
